author: Chase Davis
title: Jordan Walker cashes in big as Cards fall short
desc: Jordan Walker went 1-for-2 in a loss to the Cubs with a home run, a walk, one run scored and four RBI.
impact: After Sunday's loss to Chicago, Walker is batting .292 with 20 home runs, 67 RBI, 54 runs scored and 11 stolen bases across 85 games. He's tied with Yordan Alvarez of the Astros for the league lead in RBI.

author: Chase Davis
title: Matthew Liberatore labors as Cards fall short against Cubs
desc: Matthew Liberatore allowed three earned runs on four hits and two walks while striking out three over five innings in Sunday's loss to the Cubs.
impact: After the defeat, Liberatore now owns a 5.34 ERA and 1.53 WHIP with a 4-6 record across 18 starts. He allowed only three hard hits and picked up six whiffs on 78 pitches. His last quality start came all the way back on May 7. He gets the Braves to wrap up his first half.

author: Chase Davis
title: Emmet Sheehan's walks keep him from going deep in loss
desc: Emmet Sheehan allowed one earned run on three hits and three walks while striking out five over 4.1 innings in Sunday's loss to the Padres.
impact: After the loss, Sheehan now has a 4.91 ERA and 1.27 WHIP with a 4-6 record across 16 starts. He allowed no hits and just one walk in his first three innings before laboring a bit in the fourth. He ended up being replaced in the fifth inning and has failed to complete six innings in five straight. His last outing of the first half comes against the Diamondbacks on Sunday.

author: Chase Davis
title: Bobby Witt Jr. swipes another bag in 5-2 win over Phillies
desc: Bobby Witt Jr. went 2-for-3 in a win over the Phillies with two runs scored, one walk and one stolen base.
impact: After Sunday's win over Philadelphia, Witt is now hitting .290 with 12 home runs, 36 RBI, 46 runs scored, and 30 stolen bases across 84 games. A high batting average and lots of steals are what he does. He's second in the league behind only Nasim Nunez in steals.

author: Chase Davis
title: Isaac Collins chips in two hits, steal in win
desc: Isaac Collins went 2-for-3 in a win over the Phillies with a double, a run scored, and a stolen base.
impact: After Sunday's win over Philadelphia, Collins is batting .235 with four home runs, 25 RBI, 32 runs scored and five stolen bases across 79 games. He's started nine of the Royals' last 10 games.

author: Chase Davis
title: Alex Lange locks down save as Royals top Phillies
desc: Alex Lange threw a scoreless frame on 11 pitches to earn the save.
impact: After Sunday's win over Philadelphia, Lange now has a 4.82 ERA and 1.45 WHIP with eight saves and one hold across 36 appearances. He needed only 11 pitches to close it out, and now has eight of the last nine saves for the Royals.

author: Chase Davis
title: Luinder Avila efficient in five as Royals top Phillies 5-2
desc: Luinder Avila allowed one earned run on three hits and one walk while striking out four over five innings in Sunday's win over the Phillies.
impact: After the win, Avila now has a 5.05 ERA and 1.59 WHIP with a 4-3 record through eight starts. He allowed five hard hits and picked up six whiffs on 69 pitches. He hasn't been able to complete six innings this season, even while being efficient so his fantasy usage is limited. He'll face the Orioles in his last start of the first half.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Zach Neto goes yard in loss to Red Sox
desc: Zach Neto went 3-for-5 in Sunday's loss to the Red Sox with a home run, a double, two runs scored, and two RBI..
impact: Neto continues a productive stretch at the plate, driving in runs in four of his last six contests. The shortstop has fought consistency issues at the plate for much of the season for manager Kurt Suzuki, slashing .231 with 19 home runs, 45 RBI, 61 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 88 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Jo Adell racks up three hits, drives in two in loss to Red Sox
desc: Jo Adell went 3-for-4 in a loss to the Red Sox with two RBI.
impact: Adell has provided mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in six of his last 12 contests. The outfielder remains one of the more streaky bats in an underwhelming Angels lineup for manager Kurt Suzuki, batting .245 with 11 home runs, 47 RBI, 39 runs scored, and three stolen bases across 90 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Ryan Johnson labors on mound in loss to Red Sox
desc: Ryan Johnson allowed two earned runs on six hits and one walk while striking out six over four innings in Sunday's loss to the Red Sox.
impact: Johnson has struggled to miss opposing bats of late, allowing three or more runs in five of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander remains another underwhelming option in the Angels rotation for manager Kurt Suzuki, posting a 6.99 ERA and 1.55 WHIP with a 1-4 record and 7.6 K/9 ratio through eight appearances.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Munetaka Murakami (hamstring) to begin rehab assignment Monday
desc: Munetaka Murakami is starting a rehab assignment on Monday with Triple-A Charlotte.
impact: Murakami will figure to require a fairly lengthy rehab assignment. He should be activated at some point after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Vinnie Pasquantino (hand) on track to begin rehab assignment Tuesday
desc: Vinnie Pasquantino remains on track to begin a rehab assignment with Triple-A Omaha on Tuesday.
impact: Pasquantino will likely figure to play in at least a handful of rehab games. He could be activated shortly after the All-Star break.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Isbel (foot) not ready for rehab assignment
desc: Kyle Isbel will not be going on a rehab assignment as expected on Tuesday.
impact: Isbel has been feeling soreness while running over the weekend. He's being re-evaluated on Monday.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Martin Perez (forearm) placed on IL
desc: The Braves placed Martín Pérez on the 15-day injured list with a left forearm contusion.
impact: Perez exited his most recent start over the weekend with the injury. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.

author: Ari Koslow
title: JR Ritchie recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Braves recalled JR Ritchie from Triple-A Gwinnett.
impact: Ritchie returns one day after he was optioned. He'll likely remain in a bullpen role.
